name: Niranjan Barik

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Niranjan Barik combines a career in political science with writing poetry and short stories in Odia and English. He has taught at Ravenshaw University and Khallikote Autonomous College, and the Fulbright Scholar directory records his 2007–08 visiting lectureship at Miles College. His poetry collection Freedom from Bondage: An Ode to Nature appeared in 2023.

His Kabita Live poems bring questioning into both private feeling and public life. ‘Cursing the Magician!’ asks why a bright day can still feel without warmth. ‘Puzzles!’ places the Konark legend of Dharama beside Socrates, considering sacrifice, the pursuit of knowledge and the pressures that established power places on those who question it.
